changes.reason: The DI compiler uses the identity of scanned providers when a TypeScript import alias resolves to their declarations. This happens during graph generation and uses the existing factory and registration contract.

kubernetes.reason: TypeScript resolves provider aliases at build time. Alias resolution has no capability, storage, or lifecycle requirements for the deployed Node host.

aws-lambda.reason: TypeScript resolves provider aliases at build time. Alias resolution has no capability, storage, or lifecycle requirements for the Lambda invocation host.

cloudflare.reason: TypeScript resolves provider aliases at build time. Alias resolution has no capability, storage, or lifecycle requirements for Workers or Node Container hosts.
